title: A digression: Leonard Chadwick, the Blue Devils and a photograph
summary: Looking at a picture, Gus recalls Chadwick and the Blue Devils, Ernest Williams, Doc Ross and Lester Young.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: This is the trumpet player that was in Specs band, Specs Redd, when I was in Ottumwa, Iowa.
Oh, yes, that's right. Yes, that's right.
See, he played with the original Blue Devils.
This guy, he's still in Kansas City.
He used to sing, he was the singer in the band. Let's see, who else -- Doc Ross, Lester Young.
Is that a picture of Lester there?
I shouldn't waste the time. Well, listen, Gus, now we got to get on.
Yeah, we got to go ahead.
